name: The Shattered Realm of Aethelgard
description: An ancient continent broken into floating skylands connected by crystalline leylines. Ancient dragonlords have fallen, leaving volatile arcane anomalies and forgotten relics.
setting: Aethelgard was once a unified empire under the Sunken Spire. When the Great Leyline Fracture occurred, mountain ranges tore free into the heavens. Cities now perch on floating archipelagos, protected by runic wardstones and skyship navigators. Magic flows like wind—unstable, luminous, and precious.
logic: Leyline crystals lose power if exposed to dragonfire.
Skyships require raw aether prisms to remain aloft between the floating isles.
Rune magic requires the speaker to vocalize in the Old Tongue; silent casting is impossible.
The Nightshroud storm in the lower depths corrupts living flesh into crystalline husks if unprotected.
NPCs respect oaths bound by blood and steel above imperial writs.

loreEntries.summary: The apocalyptic cataclysm 300 years ago that tore the continent into floating skylands.
The drowned capital resting at the bottom of the abyssal mist, rumored to hold the Prime Hearth.
Humming turquoise crystals mined from falling star fragments, essential for flight and wards.

characters.name: Kaelen Ashthorn
characters.bio: A disgraced warden of the Citadel who bound an unstable lightning prism into a notched silver broadsword.

characters.name: Lady Vespera Nightshade
characters.bio: An outcast noble scholar searching for the lost astrological grimoires of the Sunken Spire.

characters.name: Borek Ironhand
characters.bio: A seasoned dwarven corsair and mechanic with a mechanical brass eye and an unshakable loyalty to his crew.

characters.name: Archon Malakor
characters.role: High Inquisitor of the Sunken Spire
characters.bio: A zealous blind mage who believes reuniting the floating islands requires purging all unregulated arcanists.
characters.secret: Secretly harnesses forbidden void glyphs to prolong his longevity.

characters.name: Lyra the Whisperer
characters.bio: Runs a hidden tavern built inside the hollow ribcage of a leviathan docked at Cloudpeak Port.
characters.secret: Owes a blood debt to the Pirate Baron of the Maelstrom.

scenarios.title: The Ghost Vessel of the Maelstrom
scenarios.description: An abandoned dreadnought skyship drifts out of the perpetual thunderclouds above Cloudpeak Port. Its distress beacon pulses with ancient violet light.
scenarios.starterAction: I steer my skiff toward the dreadnought's open cargo bay and secure my grapple rope.

scenarios.title: Infiltration of the Sunken Vaults
scenarios.description: Deep within the flooded ruins of the Citadel, a sealed gate carved with weeping seraphs has begun to resonate with your aether compass.
scenarios.starterAction: I light a flare, draw my weapon, and step past the broken seal into the echoing hall.
